summary: architecture_boundary は pass。Meeting Pack Graph SSOT DAG/playbook と Decision human gate/output pairing は、WorkflowService の ingest orchestration、workflow repository の汎用 ledger、Companion approval inbox の既存 projection 境界内に収まっており、Graph/Companion/repository 間の新しい直結依存は確認しませんでした。
inspection_summary: 指定 HEAD 8c2924e1632fe9ce321442f202961dd151663008 で、review request、現在の VibePro verification evidence、関連 diff、WorkflowService/repository/routes/Companion/bootstrap、仕様・architecture docs、契約テストを読み取り専用で確認しました。既存 review-result は e7cc6ad5d 向けだったため判断材料からは除外し、current HEAD の証跡と実装を正にしました。
inspection_evidence: server/services/workflow/workflow-service.js:2099-2162: Graph SSOT lookup is inside WorkflowService and uses injected infoSSOTService.getContext after project scope is known.

server/services/workflow/workflow-service.js:2360-2742: ingest creates workflow run, context snapshots, outputs, and human steps via repository; Decision gate pairs to output_id/output_key/output_type/approval_kind/write_back_target metadata.
server/services/workflow/workflow-service.js:947-1069: graph playbook and snapshot are generated as read/context artifacts; promoted_to_graph_ssot remains false and no Graph write path is introduced.
server/services/workflow/workflow-repository.js:128-223: repository remains generic createRun/createHumanStep/createOutput persistence, with no Graph or Companion-specific behavior.
server/routes/workflows.js:179-193: review package ingest route delegates to WorkflowService without embedding Graph/Companion logic.

server/routes/companion.js:21-80 and server/services/workflow/workflow-service.js:3496-3575: Companion approval inbox goes through access guard and WorkflowService read projection; it lists runs/steps/outputs/snapshots rather than mutating Graph or bypassing repository.
server/bootstrap/core-services.js:68-94: InfoSSOTService, JsonFileWorkflowRepository, WorkflowRunner, and WorkflowService are wired by dependency injection, preserving intended dependency direction.

docs/architecture/meeting-pack-graph-ssot-playbook-architecture.md:13-78 and docs/specs/story-meeting-pack-graph-ssot-playbook-spec.md:119-142: intended boundary documents match implementation: Graph is context/read authority, approval gates protect promotion/write-back targets.

tests/e2e/story-meeting-pack-graph-ssot-playbook-contract.spec.ts:218-390,465-570: contract covers project-scoped Graph lookup, pre-ingest blockers before Graph lookup, fallback evidence, DAG, and Decision gate metadata.
tests/server/routes/companion-approval-inbox.test.js:209-295,377-428: Companion inbox exposes decision_candidates as actionable approval and verifies output_id linkage, not output_only.

.vibepro/pr/story-meeting-pack-graph-ssot-playbook/verification-evidence.json:22-176: current HEAD evidence records vitest pass and Playwright pass for Decision approval pairing; older e7cc6ad5d integration entry was not treated as current-head proof.
judgment_delta: 初期懸念: Graph SSOT playbook が WorkflowService 外で Graph/Companion/repository を結合している可能性 -> 最終判断: Graph lookup and playbook generation stay inside WorkflowService with injected InfoSSOTService and repository writes only.

初期懸念: Decision human gate/output pairing が Companion 専用 coupling を repository schema に持ち込む可能性 -> 最終判断: pairing is generic human_step/output metadata; Companion only projects it through existing approval inbox flow.
